title: M3 离线主矩阵、回放、消融与 BKT 预测
claim_scope: 冻结 Fake Provider 开发案例的路径完成度、策略字段核对和合成历史预测指标；不代表教师评分或学生学习结果。

data_source.unit: fixed constructed case cells, decisions, references and predictions

generator.backend: R / ggplot2 + patchwork; ragg, svglite and base R PDF

data_invariants.details: CSV has 12 rows; matrices sum to 400/400; all offline summary numerators and denominators match the frozen run.

checks.r_parse: not re-run: Rscript is unavailable in the release container; the change only redirects the input to the redacted summary wrapper.

notes: Static R syntax check requests a real parse; R parse(file=...) also passed.
No journal-specific width is configured for this internal report figure.

png_visual_review.details: Reviewed full-size PNG after final render; all four panels, labels and notes are legible with no visible clipping or collisions.

pdf_collision_audit.details: Base R PDF geometry audit reports no text collisions or clipping after label/gridline adjustments.

pdf_text_audit.details: Generic content-stream Tf audit interprets R PDF scale transforms as 1 pt; independent PyMuPDF extraction yields visible text spans of 6–12 pt, all within page boundaries. Preserve the discrepancy rather than treating the generic scan as a pass.

redacted_source_validation.details: Python report validation cross-checks the redacted summary, frozen run denominators and the 12-row F09 CSV; the figure input values are unchanged.

limitations: All cases and learning outcomes are constructed; no students or teacher raters were involved.
The BKT model uses unfit development parameters and has poor prediction metrics (AUC 0.296, Brier 0.366, log loss 0.936, ECE 0.530).
Reference locatability does not verify semantic support.
The content-stream font scanner does not account for the PDF transform matrix; visible text size was cross-checked with PyMuPDF and the discrepancy remains documented.
R rendering was not repeated in the final container because Rscript is unavailable; the existing figure content uses unchanged CSV metrics and prior visual QA remains documented.
